title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4EHAW - Helper
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/Helper. Helper of patients/users, e.g. a patient's relative (ttl rdfs:comment). Modelled as a subClassOf HealthActor; inherits firstName, lastName, dob, phone, hasMbox, gender, ageCategory, hasPhysicalLocation, usesBan and hasActivity from HealthActor (see standards/saref4ehaw/models/HealthActor/schema.json), in addition to its own followsUser property declared below.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Helper'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

followsUser.description: Relationship. A helper may follow one or multiple users that can in particular be patients. ttl-confirmed, domain Helper, range User (s4ehaw:followsUser). Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/User'. May also be an array of URIs when a helper follows more than one user.
